verdict.rationale: Glama's own gateway docs say every MCP call through the gateway URL is logged and that you "know exactly what your AI is doing," so first-party tool-call logging exists. The evidence never describes what the logs contain or how they are accessed, so audit and replay depth is unproven. Missing for 10: documentation of log contents (tool arguments and responses, timestamps, agent identity), a log viewer or export/API, replay capability, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can see a log of every tool call that passed through the platform, with enough detail to audit or replay what an agent did

citations.quote: Every call through this URL is logged, access-controlled, and credential-managed
Every MCP call from your agents flows through Glama – so you know exactly what your AI is doing
Deploy any server from the registry to Glama and we automatically put the Gateway in front of it.
